scope: Independent targeted regression of the two previously reproduced P1 privacy bypasses and the adjacent compiled-cache alias path; native Linux CLI only.
method: Fresh isolated profiles staged from the frozen project; subprocess invocation of core/build/ime-core with synthetic commands; user-directory byte hashes and userdb absence checked. No project source was changed and the 42-check full suite was not rerun.

cases.method: Kept the three translator/ privacy flags false; replaced the effective translator with table_translator@remember and enabled learning in remember/.
cases.stderr: ime-core: Refusing profile: trusted source or no-learning patch was modified.

cases.method: Added a default-learning extra schema and placed it first in schema_list while preserving all approved schema privacy patches.
cases.stderr: ime-core: Refusing unexpected user schema, script, or saved dictionary.

cases.method: Successfully deployed a clean profile, then changed only the compiled schema to a learning-enabled named translator; source files and privacy patches were unchanged.
cases.stderr: ime-core: Refusing schema: approved components or no-learning policy differ.
cases.rejection_gate: CheckPrivacy effective-schema validation after maintenance, before create_session

remaining_limits: The first two modified-source cases are rejected before Rime initialization or maintenance; the compiled-cache case is rejected after maintenance but before any input session is created.
This is a targeted regression result for the exact binary and tested scenarios, not an exhaustive security audit or a guarantee against compromised host software or concurrent local tampering.
Windows TSF, Android, iOS, installers and platform permissions were not exercised.
